set.prohibitedLiteralsNote: Structured prohibition data (rev 19 section F(b), amended by rev 20 section B): the walker fails if any of these literals exists anywhere under src/, falcon.js, scripts/, package.json or .github/, with exactly one carve-out defined in prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut. None is a Phase 18 capability, obligation or claim. The section F lint and the claims grep both skip this key and the prohibitedLiterals array by name, so a prohibition can never read as a live approval obligation and cannot inflate the claims baseline.

prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.pattern: a single frozen array literal of rejected environment-variable names, REJECTED_ENV_KEYS, whose only member is the string PILOT_APPROVAL_RUN_TOKEN
prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.rule: The walker permits exactly one occurrence of this literal, in exactly this file, inside exactly this pattern, and fails on a second occurrence anywhere, on an occurrence in any other file, on an occurrence outside that pattern, and on any read of the variable's value. The value is never echoed, logged, reported, written to a receipt, dashboard, report or artefact, and never compared against anything. Presence alone triggers refusal, including when the variable is set to the empty string, so the check is key presence in process.env and never a value test.
prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.refusal: PILOT_CONFIG_REJECTED_ENV_KEY, exit 2, emitted before any browser launch, any context creation, any filesystem write under run/ and any request to the target (rev 20 section B)

neg-token-refusal-silence: the value string appears in no log line, report, receipt, dashboard payload or artefact

lintBaseline.method: Case-insensitive, leftmost-longest, NON-OVERLAPPING alternation over the token list: scan each file left to right; at each position take the longest matching token, count one hit and advance past it; otherwise advance one character. Overlapping tokens therefore count once (approver inside PILOT_APPROVER, RunToken inside RunTokenEmitter, PILOT_APPROVAL inside PILOT_APPROVAL_RUN_TOKEN). Scope: tracked files, excluding docs/security/phase-18-design-review*.md (glob fixed by rev 20: the rev 19 glob missed docs/security/phase-18-design-review.md), docs/architecture/phase-18-rev* and docs/pilot-deferred/ (exact prefix with the trailing slash; docs/pilot/ is a different, live prefix and must also be matched with its trailing slash). Self-exclusion: for docs/phase-18-acceptance-criteria.json the file is parsed, the lintBaseline subtree and every criterion's prohibitedLiterals array are removed, and the count is taken over the concatenation of the remaining keys and string values in document order joined by newline, so the baseline and the prohibition data cannot inflate the count and the result does not depend on JSON formatting.
